users.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `users` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  `email` VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
  `salt` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
  `role_id` INT,
  `department_id` INT,

documents.create_sql:
